zh: 插件可以把组件画在页面里：浏览器侧的 `widgetBoard.registerWidgetType` 登记一个 React 组件，与组件库里同 id 的组件对上之后，卡片改用这个组件渲染，参数与 `window.widget` 同形，抛错只废掉那一张卡。组件还可以在 manifest 里声明默认的数据源，加卡片时按它取第一次数据。仓库带了一个提供方 fixture，冒烟装上它走一遍注册、显示与移除。
en: Plugins can draw a widget in the page: the browser-side `widgetBoard.registerWidgetType` registers a React component, and once it matches a library widget by id the card renders it with the same parameters as `window.widget`, while a throw only breaks that one card. A widget can also name a default data source in its manifest, read when the card is added. The repository ships a provider fixture that the smoke installs, renders and removes.
